notes:
Reading, appearance and finding your place.

READING
- The Quran now uses a proper mushaf typeface, Amiri Quran, in place of the phone's default Arabic font. It is used everywhere Arabic appears.
- Text size: A minus and A plus beside the page number, from small to very large, remembered for next time.
- The reader follows the recitation. While audio plays, the ayah being recited is highlighted and the page turns to keep up. Turn a page yourself and it waits a few seconds before following again.
- Long surahs and paras now open without the screen stalling, with a Loading message while the text arrives.

FINDING WHAT YOU WANT
- Search surah, on both the Quran tab and the Audio Quran tab. Type part of a name and go straight there, instead of scrolling.

HOME
- Continue where you left off: the last surah or para you were reading, and the last you were listening to, each waiting on the home screen.
- Ayah of the day is a real ayah now, the same one for everyone that day, with a button to open it in the reader.

PLAYER
- The reciter's name is a button. Change voice in the middle of a recitation and it keeps your place: same ayah, same position, still playing.

APPEARANCE
- Dark mode now works properly, and the switch in Settings applies it straight away. It follows your phone's setting by default.
- Colours corrected where text or controls were too faint to read: gold text and the slider handle in the light theme, and the play icon in the dark theme.
- Buttons grow with your font size instead of clipping their labels.
- Tablets and landscape get comfortable margins rather than lines of text running the full width.

TIDYING
- Removed the switches in Settings that did nothing: notifications, the accessibility placeholder and the volume slider.
- Removed the gender field from the profile.
- Removed the mini player from the Audio tab.
